events.title: IMA Gala & Benefit Auction 2026 — Online Bidding Opens
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: The Institute of Modern Art's annual benefit auction opens for online bidding on Wednesday 22 July, allowing public access to view and bid on artworks to support Australian artists and cultural projects.

events.title: Angela Tiatia Exhibition at IMA (Ongoing)
events.location: Institute of Modern Art, Fortitude Valley
events.description: Explore Angela Tiatia's landmark first survey exhibition at the Institute of Modern Art, showcasing her work that blends beauty and resistance, open free to the public Tuesday to Sunday.

events.title: d harding: Site, Non Site, Place (Milani Gallery)
events.description: Experience the final days of *Site, Non Site, Place*, a solo exhibition by significant First Nations conceptual artist d harding at Milani Gallery, exploring themes of place and non-place.

events.title: James Guppy: Sculptures and Birds (Jan Murphy Gallery)
events.description: Visit Jan Murphy Gallery to see *Sculptures and Birds*, an imaginative solo exhibition by James Guppy, showcasing tactile artworks from one of the gallery's engaging artists.

events.title: Guido Maestri: Arrangements (Jan Murphy Gallery)
events.description: See *Arrangements* by Guido Maestri at Jan Murphy Gallery, an exhibition of richly decorative and narrative paintings running concurrently with James Guppy's show.

events.title: Hurtigruten Nordic Film Festival
events.description: Experience the best new cinema from Denmark, Finland, Iceland, Norway, and Sweden at the Hurtigruten Nordic Film Festival, showcasing unique storytelling and breathtaking landscapes.

events.title: Golden Years Screenings at Palace Barracks
events.description: Enjoy discounted film screenings at Palace Barracks' Golden Years event, a recurring community gathering on Wednesdays for seniors to watch selected titles.

events.title: HSBNE Tuesday Open Night — Hackerspace Tour
events.description: Visit HSBNE's community-driven makerspace on their open night for a free tour, exploring workshops in woodworking, electronics, 3D printing, and more, ideal for creative and curious individuals.

events.title: Board Game Weekly Meetup
events.description: Join a welcoming, recurring community board game session at Vault Games for tabletop enthusiasts of all levels to play and socialize.

events.title: Brisbane City Fountain Pen Meet — July
events.description: A casual monthly gathering for fountain pen enthusiasts and collectors to discuss and share their passion for analogue writing culture over drinks.

events.title: Latin Dance Picnic at Kangaroo Point
events.description: Enjoy an outdoor community social with Latin music and dancing at Kangaroo Point Square, offering a vibrant atmosphere in a scenic riverside location.

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival: Backstory Factory Workshop
events.description: An interactive workshop from the Brisbane Improv Festival focused on improvisation, character-building, and collaborative storytelling, suitable for creatives and performers.

events.title: Brisbane Improv Festival: Ben Russell & Friends
events.description: Enjoy a live improv performance by Ben Russell & Friends as part of the Brisbane Improv Festival, blending comedy, creativity, and audience interaction for an engaging experience.

events.title: Meditation and Mindset Workshop
events.description: A grounded, practical weekend workshop in Brisbane focusing on meditation techniques and mental clarity, designed for authentic personal development.

events.title: Sunday Stories at QPM: The Disappearance of Sharron Phillips
events.description: A thoughtful storytelling and historical discussion event at the Queensland Police Museum, exploring the cold case of Sharron Phillips, aimed at curious and community-driven attendees.

events.title: Life Painting with Female Model (BYO)
events.description: Participate in a hands-on, intimate figure drawing session with a live model in Brisbane City, open to artists of all levels in a casual and creative community setting.
